post.description: Requires memory_read and an exact scope grant. One authorized snapshot provides current records and statistics. Check exhaustive before interpreting a corpus page as complete; separate BM25 page scores cannot be merged into a global ranking. Text and externally generated query vector are explicit. Pin weighted_rrf_v1 or weighted_rrf_v2; weights, method and candidate cap are server-owned. Inspect embedding_coverage and candidates_truncated. Raw channel scores, ranks, contributions and vector receipts explain each hit. Storage errors fail the entire request; missing vectors are reported, never silently labeled full hybrid coverage. Experimental: no held-out relevance gain is claimed. Vector requests have a 2 MiB JSON body cap and support up to 32768 dimensions, subject to the configured operator ceiling.
